world-politics.title: Iran War Live Updates: Drone Hits Kuwaiti Oil Refinery in New Attack on Gulf Energy Sites
world-politics.summary: An Iranian drone struck Kuwait's Mina Al-Ahmadi oil refinery, triggering fires across key units as emergency teams responded. Attacks on Gulf energy infrastructure and shipping have continued to disrupt global supplies, pushing oil prices sharply higher.

world-politics.title: Trump Threatens to Bomb Iran 'Back to Stone Ages,' Gives No Exit Timeline
world-politics.summary: President Trump delivered a prime-time address vowing the U.S. would continue strikes on Iran for two to three more weeks, calling it 'Operation Fury.' He provided no diplomatic exit strategy and gave Iran until April 6 to reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

world-politics.title: Over 40 Nations Meet in UK to Discuss Reopening Strait of Hormuz
world-politics.summary: Foreign ministers from more than 40 countries held a virtual meeting convened by UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer to find ways to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, through which only 5 vessels passed in the last 24 hours versus the normal 150. The U.S. did not attend.

world-politics.title: Russia Claims Complete Control of Ukraine's Luhansk Region
world-politics.summary: Russian military leaders announced they have taken full control of eastern Ukraine's Luhansk region, one of four areas Russia illegally annexed in 2022. Meanwhile, Ukraine's Zelensky condemned Russia for rejecting an Orthodox Easter holiday truce, as Moscow fired 700+ drones at civilian infrastructure.

world-politics.title: Trump Considers Pulling U.S. Out of NATO, Calls Alliance a 'Paper Tiger'
world-politics.summary: President Trump stated he is 'absolutely' considering withdrawing the U.S. from NATO, amid deep divisions with European allies who have refused to join the U.S.-Israeli war on Iran. France's Macron called Trump's statements about the war 'unserious' and said they undermine the alliance.

world-politics.title: Macron Voices Europe's Frustration With Trump as Missiles Fly Across Middle East
world-politics.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron sharply rebuked President Trump over his handling of the Iran war and his demeaning comments about NATO allies, calling Trump's shifting statements 'unserious.' Iran and Hezbollah continued missile attacks on Israel, with 14 people wounded near Tel Aviv.

us-politics.title: Trump Fires Attorney General Pam Bondi, Names Personal Lawyer Todd Blanche as Acting AG
us-politics.summary: President Trump abruptly fired Attorney General Pam Bondi via a Truth Social post, citing her move to 'the private sector.' Bondi faced criticism from Trump allies over her handling of the Jeffrey Epstein files. Trump's personal defense lawyer Todd Blanche was named acting AG.

us-politics.title: Supreme Court Appears Likely to Rule Against Trump on Birthright Citizenship
us-politics.summary: After two-plus hours of oral arguments — attended by Trump himself in a historic first — a majority of Supreme Court justices, including conservatives, appeared skeptical of the administration's bid to end birthright citizenship. Chief Justice Roberts called a key element of the administration's argument 'very quirky.'

us-politics.title: Republicans Announce Two-Track Plan to End Partial DHS Shutdown
us-politics.summary: House Speaker Mike Johnson and Senate Majority Leader John Thune announced a plan to fund most of the Department of Homeland Security through September while using budget reconciliation to fund ICE and Border Patrol separately. House Republicans showed resistance, and the shutdown may drag on through the April recess.

us-politics.title: Trump Strengthens Tariffs on Steel, Aluminum, and Copper Imports
us-politics.summary: President Trump signed a Proclamation strengthening Section 232 tariffs on imported steel, aluminum, and copper, citing national security. The White House said the U.S. became the world's third-largest steel producer in 2025 as a result of prior tariff policy.

us-politics.title: 4 Takeaways From Trump's Iran War Address: No Exit Strategy, Escalation Confirmed
us-politics.summary: Trump's prime-time White House address on the Iran war offered no new details on diplomatic progress or an exit strategy, while confirming continued strikes for two to three more weeks. As the conflict approaches the 60-day War Powers Act threshold, Trump has yet to seek Congressional approval.

us-politics.title: Trump Signs Executive Order to Create National Registry of Eligible Voters
us-politics.summary: President Trump signed an executive order directing DHS and the SSA to compile a national list of eligible voters ahead of this year's midterm elections, citing mail-in voting fraud. Voting rights advocates immediately signaled legal challenges, arguing the president has no constitutional authority over state elections.

dfw-politics.title: Rappers Pooh Shiesty and BIG30 Among 9 Federally Charged in Violent Dallas Studio Kidnapping
dfw-politics.summary: Federal authorities charged nine individuals — including Memphis rappers Pooh Shiesty (Lontrell Williams Jr.) and BIG30 (Rodney Wright Jr.) — with kidnapping and armed robbery at a Dallas Parkway music studio in January. Prosecutors say Williams forced a victim at gunpoint to sign a release from Gucci Mane's record label.

dfw-politics.title: Heavy Rain and Thunderstorms to Impact DFW Easter Weekend Plans
dfw-politics.summary: A cold front pushing through North Texas is expected to bring widespread rain and 1-2 inches of precipitation to the DFW area on Saturday, April 4, before clearing by Saturday evening. Easter Sunday is forecast to be dry with partly sunny skies and a high near 70.

dfw-politics.title: Fort Worth ISD State-Appointed Board Meets Publicly for First Time Under TEA Takeover
dfw-politics.summary: Fort Worth ISD's new state-appointed board of managers held its first public meeting under the Texas Education Agency takeover, electing leadership and addressing the acting superintendent agreement. State-appointed superintendent Dr. Peter Lucata pledged to improve teacher pay and raise academic performance across the district's 11 failing campuses.

dfw-politics.title: Dallas-Fort Worth Records Warmest March in History at 67.6°F Average
dfw-politics.summary: DFW hit an average temperature of 67.6 degrees in March 2026, smashing the record for the area's warmest March on record after several days in the 80s and 90s. The heat came as part of a wider pattern of elevated spring temperatures across the region.

dfw-politics.title: Texas Rangers Host Home Opener vs. Cincinnati Reds at Globe Life Field Today
dfw-politics.summary: The Texas Rangers open their 2026 home schedule today at Globe Life Field in Arlington, hosting the Cincinnati Reds at 3:05 PM. It marks the first home game for the defending champions in front of their home crowd this season.

dfw-politics.title: Project Safe Neighborhoods Expands Violent Crime Crackdown Across North Texas
dfw-politics.summary: Federal, state, and local law enforcement announced an expansion of Project Safe Neighborhoods to additional North Texas communities including northwest and northeast Dallas, Amarillo, and Lubbock. The initiative targets repeat violent offenders, drug trafficking, and illegal weapons following a deadly shooting at a Fort Worth park.

ai-news.title: Google Launches Gemma 4 Open-Source AI Family Under Apache 2.0 License
ai-news.summary: Google released Gemma 4, its most powerful open AI model family to date, in four sizes from a 2B edge model to a 31B dense model that ranks third on the Arena AI open-model leaderboard. Built on the same research as Gemini 3, it is the first Gemma release under the permissive Apache 2.0 license — a change Hugging Face called 'a huge milestone.'

ai-news.title: OpenAI Closes $122 Billion Funding Round, Now Valued at $852 Billion
ai-news.summary: OpenAI closed one of the largest funding rounds in history at $122 billion, pushing its valuation to $852 billion as the company prepares for a potential IPO later in 2026. The company is generating $2 billion per month in revenue, and GPT-5.4 has already scored 83% on OpenAI's GDPVal benchmark for economically valuable knowledge work.

ai-news.title: Anthropic's Claude Code Source Code Accidentally Leaked to Public
ai-news.summary: Anthropic confirmed that over 512,000 lines of its internal Claude Code CLI source code were accidentally released publicly, which the company attributed to human error. The leak exposed the full codebase of Anthropic's coding assistant to competitors and security researchers.

ai-news.title: Morgan Stanley Warns AI Breakthrough Is Imminent in First Half of 2026
ai-news.summary: Morgan Stanley issued a sweeping report warning that a transformative leap in artificial intelligence is imminent and that most of the world is not ready for it. The bank cited unprecedented compute accumulation at major AI labs and noted that GPT-5.4 already scores at or above human-expert level on economically valuable tasks.

ai-news.title: OpenAI Shuts Down Sora Video Platform, Citing Unsustainable Compute Costs
ai-news.summary: OpenAI quietly discontinued its Sora public API and consumer video generation platform, citing unsustainable inference costs per generated minute. Active users had dropped from 1 million to under 500,000, and the company has redirected resources toward enterprise and productivity-focused tools.

ai-news.title: SpaceX Acquires xAI in All-Stock Deal, Creating World's Most Valuable Private Company
ai-news.summary: Elon Musk's SpaceX completed its acquisition of xAI, the maker of the Grok chatbot, in an all-stock merger valuing xAI at $125 billion and SpaceX at $1 trillion — making it the world's most valuable private company. The deal deepens Musk's AI and space ventures into a vertically integrated platform.

jpmorgan-chase.title: JPMorgan Q1 2026 Earnings Call Set for April 14 — EPS Projected at $5.42
jpmorgan-chase.summary: JPMorgan Chase will report Q1 2026 results on April 14 at 7:00 AM ET, with analyst consensus projecting EPS of $5.42 — a 6.9% year-over-year increase. The bank is expected to show a 17% surge in Markets revenue and a strong 17% Return on Tangible Common Equity driven by trading volatility from the Iran conflict.

jpmorgan-chase.title: Jamie Dimon Launches $80 Billion 'American Dream Initiative' for Small Businesses
jpmorgan-chase.summary: JPMorgan CEO Jamie Dimon announced the American Dream Initiative, committing nearly $80 billion in small business lending over the next decade and targeting growth from 7 million to 10 million small business clients. Dimon warned that 'the American Dream is alive, but it's slipping out of reach for too many people.'

jpmorgan-chase.title: JPMorgan Asserts Market Dominance Amid Global Energy Crisis, Stock Near $294
jpmorgan-chase.summary: As the Iran conflict sent Brent crude past $100 per barrel, JPMorgan has leveraged its diversified revenue streams and $2 billion annual AI investment to weather the storm better than peers. While Goldman Sachs is down 10% YTD, JPMorgan has maintained a consensus price target of $339 among analysts.

jpmorgan-chase.title: JPMorgan's Q1 Earnings Are the Market's 'Vibe Check' for the Global Economy
jpmorgan-chase.summary: Analysts say JPMorgan's April 14 earnings release will serve as the definitive tone-setter for the global economy, confirming or denying a soft landing for the American consumer. Investment banking fees are projected to surge by mid-to-high teens year-over-year, while the key risk to watch is accelerating credit card delinquencies.

jpmorgan-chase.title: JPMorgan Forecasts Mid-to-High Teens Jump in Q1 Investment Banking Fees
jpmorgan-chase.summary: JPMorgan guided for investment banking fees to increase by mid-to-high-teens year-over-year in Q1 2026, driven by a clearing backlog of M&A and IPO deals and strong trading volumes from market volatility. The bank also plans to spend $19.8 billion on technology in 2026, up 10%, with AI investments showing tangible returns.

jpmorgan-chase.title: Jamie Dimon Renews Return-to-Office Stance Amid Employee Petition
jpmorgan-chase.summary: JPMorgan Chase CEO Jamie Dimon doubled down on the bank's full return-to-office policy, just days after an internal employee petition calling for more flexibility gathered over 2,000 signatures. Dimon has remained one of Wall Street's most vocal opponents of remote work arrangements.

dfw-events.title: Texas Rangers Home Opener: Reds at Rangers — April 3, 3:05 PM at Globe Life Field
dfw-events.summary: The Texas Rangers kick off their 2026 home schedule today at Globe Life Field in Arlington against the Cincinnati Reds, with first pitch at 3:05 PM. It's the first chance for DFW fans to see the Rangers play at home this season.

dfw-events.title: Scarborough Renaissance Festival Opens for 45th Anniversary Season — Weekends April 4–May 25
dfw-events.summary: The beloved Scarborough Renaissance Festival in Waxahachie kicks off its 45th anniversary season this weekend, running every weekend through Memorial Day. The immersive 16th-century English village features 20+ stages, 200+ artisan shoppes, rides, themed weekends, and period entertainment for all ages.

dfw-events.title: Collect A Con at Fort Worth Convention Center — April 4–5
dfw-events.summary: Collect A Con returns to the Fort Worth Convention Center Arena this weekend, bringing together collectors of pop culture memorabilia, trading cards, comics, and more. The two-day event opens Saturday, April 4 at 10:00 AM and Sunday, April 5 at 10:00 AM.

dfw-events.title: Irving Margarita Festival at Toyota Music Factory — Saturday, April 4
dfw-events.summary: The Irving Margarita Festival takes over Toyota Music Factory on Saturday, April 4 from 12:00–6:00 PM, featuring margarita tastings, live music, and a festive outdoor atmosphere. It's one of the most popular spring kickoff events in the DFW area.

dfw-events.title: Dallas Blooms 'Enchantment of Orchids' Continues at Dallas Arboretum Through April 12
dfw-events.summary: The Southwest's largest annual floral festival is in full swing at the Dallas Arboretum, featuring over 500,000 spring-blooming flowers including 350,000 tulips under this year's theme 'Enchantment of Orchids.' The festival runs through April 12, with weekly performances, family activities, and a curated orchid exhibition.

dfw-events.title: Stockyards Championship Rodeo at Cowtown Coliseum — Tonight at 7:30 PM
dfw-events.summary: The weekly Stockyards Championship Rodeo rides tonight at Cowtown Coliseum in Fort Worth at 7:30 PM, offering bull riding, barrel racing, and other classic Western events in the historic Fort Worth Stockyards. Additional performances are scheduled Saturday at 1:30 and 7:30 PM.
